scale: WMO CO2 X2019 for NOAA data since 1974; verified change log March 2021
attribution: Data provided by NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, Carbon Cycle and Greenhouse Gases group, Boulder, Colorado, USA. Full source includes Scripps data before May 1974; analysis subset uses NOAA period only.
product_level: Calibrated background-air monthly means, adjusted to month center; not raw analyzer outputs.
course_derivative: 1990-2021 rows extracted without changing values; course models are not official NOAA products.
